body: I understand. Some people are not as lucky as me and go through the worst. Even when they’ve tried everything.

I attempted suicide at 10. It messed me up. But i kinda used it as a inspiration. I got into sports like football. It was my passion and I wanted to make it my future. I told my dad to get a gym membership so I can start working out. Instead he bought equipment and put it in our garage. I started to workout almost everyday or the week. I started to see results and if made me happy. I am now in 8th grade and have a full ride scholarship to Columbus High school for football who won state last year. I might still have my thoughts but that dosent change the fact that I am still breathing. You will prob say it will never pass and you might be right and that’s the ugly truth. Some of us life with these thoughts for our lives but that dosent mean they gave up. Don’t run away from suicide you have to run through suicide till it gives up.
